tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark-first: near-black like the CV header; Light theme = warm paper like the CV body.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Large panels: project cards, nav bar, article column on wide screens.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Elements above surface: hovered cards, menus, spec tables, IDE tab strip.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks and terminal panels. Stays dark in Light too (like the CV header band).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Emphasised dividers, table header rules, graph-paper major lines on surfaces.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, ghost buttons and chips that must be seen: ≥3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: Graph-paper minor grid (every space-5 = 24px). Pure texture — never carries meaning.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Graph-paper major grid (every 5 cells = 120px) and plot axes background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy in long articles (dark), secondary text, card summaries — on bg, surface, surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Metadata: dates, hashes, line numbers, captions — on bg, surface, surface-raised (≥4.5:1). Never for sentences.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE brand accent — Ember (CV orange tuned for dark). Section labels, links, prompt `$`, the cursor, primary button fill, active tab underline. One accent per view; never for body text blocks. Light theme uses a darker ember for 4.5:1.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of accent; accent text on accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent content: selected nav item, highlighted line in code, active chip.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, cursor block).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Solid accent ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Build passing, 'shipped' status. Always paired with a word or glyph (✓ / 'done').

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: 'WIP' status, caveats. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, 'archived/lost' status. Always paired with a word; differs from success in hue AND is never the only cue.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Default code text on surface-sunken (all themes).

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Comments, line numbers and punctuation in code, on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: code-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside code/terminal panels (tab strip, gutter rule) on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: code-highlight
tokens.usage: Background of a highlighted code line (the line the prose is talking about).

tokens.name: code-danger
tokens.usage: Error output inside terminal and code panels (surface-sunken), in every theme. Always with words (error:, No such file…).

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (if, for, return, class). Follows the accent; in Light the dark code panel uses the bright ember.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: String and char literals on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Numeric literals and constants on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: syn-fn
tokens.usage: Function and method names on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Types, classes, templates on surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ember-500
tokens.usage: Raw Ember, identical in both themes. Use ONLY on dark grounds that never flip (code panels, favicon, logo on dark). In UI use `accent`.

tokens.name: hue-cyan
tokens.usage: Project color 'cyan'. Only for project content (header art, diagrams, highlighted code, map point) via --project. Never for UI chrome. ≥4.5:1 on bg/surface/surface-raised and on hue-cyan-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: hue-cyan-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for project color 'cyan' (chips, highlighted lines, active layer).

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero name only. One per page.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Article H2 sections (H1 is the project title).

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Article H3, card titles on landing.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: I wanted to understand every photon, so I wrote the renderer without a single library.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Monte Carlo integration over the hemisphere.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels — ALWAYS uppercase, in `accent`. The CV signature. Pair with an index: `01 — PROFILE`.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, commit hashes, file paths, breadcrumbs, status bar. `ink-faint`.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: Terminal-voice headings and nav (TerminalHeading). `$` in accent.

styles.name: code
styles.sample: vec3 radiance(const Ray& r, int depth);

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; label-to-title gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip horizontal padding, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (compact), code block padding, mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: THE grid cell: graph-paper minor pitch, card padding, paragraph gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; heading top margin in articles.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between article sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections (3 grid cells).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Graph-paper major pitch (5 cells); hero top padding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Graph-paper figures, section rules, the cursor block — anything that should feel plotted.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Chips/Tags (as in the CV), inline code, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, terminal panels. Maximum radius in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only for floating overlays (command palette, menus). Cards use borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of article text (body-l).

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Article column incl. code blocks and figures.

tokens.name: wide-width
tokens.usage: Landing grid and wide figures.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: All borders and grid lines.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phone breakpoint. `@container screen (max-width: 640px)`: one column, edge-to-edge code/media/tables, 44px hero name, touch-size plot points. Container conditions cannot read var(): repeat the number.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet breakpoint. `@container screen (max-width: 900px)`: TOC collapses into a bar above the article, hero stacks plot under the man page.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable on phones (nav tabs, options rows, plot points incl. hit area).
